fields.name: projectName
fields.label: Project name
fields.description: What is the name of your project? (≤10 words)

fields.name: registryId
fields.label: Registry ID
fields.description: If applicable, provide your registry ID (e.g. VCS1234 or GS12345).

fields.name: registryUrl
fields.label: Registry URL
fields.description: If applicable, provide the URL link to your project's website on the registry.

fields.name: projectType
fields.label: Project type
fields.description: Select the project type. Values should align with the Carbon Data Open Protocol (CDOP) enumerated list for 'project type', or 'Other'.

fields.name: creditingProgram
fields.label: Crediting program
fields.description: Select the crediting program (standards body / registry) you have selected for your project. Values should align with the Carbon Data Open Protocol (CDOP) enumerated list for 'crediting program' (43 options), or 'Other'.

fields.name: methodology
fields.label: Methodology (protocol)
fields.description: What methodology (protocol) are you using to quantify emissions for this project? Values should align with the Carbon Data Open Protocol (CDOP) enumerated list for 'methodology', or 'Other'.

fields.name: methodologyVersion
fields.label: Methodology version
fields.description: What version of the methodology is being used to quantify emissions for this project? (≤10 words)

fields.name: methodologyUrl
fields.label: Methodology URL
fields.description: If available, provide a URL link to the selected methodology.

fields.name: projectStatus
fields.label: Project status
fields.description: What is the project status? Aligned with CDOP recommendations, filtered for procurement-relevant options.

fields.name: mitigationOutcome
fields.label: Mitigation outcome
fields.description: What mitigation outcome does this project support?

fields.name: projectDescription
fields.label: Project description
fields.description: Provide a description of the project. Include an overview of the project's activities and theory of change. (≤200 words)

fields.name: projectStartDate
fields.label: Project start date
fields.description: Format: MM/YYYY (e.g. 06/2025).

fields.name: creditingPeriodStartDate
fields.label: Crediting period start date
fields.description: Format: MM/YYYY (e.g. 06/2025).

fields.name: creditingPeriodEndDate
fields.label: Crediting period end date
fields.description: Format: MM/YYYY (e.g. 06/2025).

fields.name: dateEstimationNotes
fields.label: Date estimation notes
fields.description: Indicate if any of the dates above are an estimation and give additional context. (≤50 words)

fields.name: technologyDifferentiation
fields.label: Technology or approach differentiation
fields.description: How does the technology/approach used in this project differ from other climate solutions? This may include patents, patent applications, proprietary know-how, exclusive data, specialized expertise, or other aspects. (≤100 words)

fields.name: additionalCertifications
fields.label: Alignment with additional certifications, labels, or initiatives
fields.description: Is the project, methodology, or chosen standard aligned with any additional certifications, market labels, or initiatives (e.g. Verra ABACUS, CCP, Forest Stewardship Council, Biodiversity Standards, W+ or similar)? If yes, describe the status and level of alignment. (≤100 words)

fields.name: region
fields.label: Region
fields.description: In what region is your project located? Values should align with the Carbon Data Open Protocol (CDOP) 'Geographical Region' enumerated list (31 options).

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: In what country is your project located? Values should be ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes, per CDOP recommendations.

fields.name: subdivision
fields.label: Country subdivision (state/province)
fields.description: In which country subdivision (state/province) is your project located? Values should be ISO 3166-2 country subdivision codes, per CDOP recommendations.

fields.name: isLeadProponent
fields.label: Submitting organization is the lead project proponent and offtake counterparty
fields.description: Is the submitting organization the lead project proponent and the counterparty that would be signing an offtake contract?

fields.name: creditOwnershipEntity
fields.label: Legal owner of credits
fields.description: What entity will have legal ownership of the credits produced by the project? Describe the relationship between the project developer and this entity as applicable. (≤50 words)

fields.name: developerCoreBusiness
fields.label: Project developer core business
fields.description: Describe the project developer's core business or activity, product, or service offering. Include any relevant project development experience, emissions reduction targets, clean energy targets, and/or any relevant R&D focus. (≤200 words)

fields.name: keyOrganizations
fields.label: Key organizations

columns.name: countryOfRegistration
columns.label: Country of legal registration
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, per CDOP.

fields.description: Give identifying information for the organizations involved in this project. Add rows as necessary.

fields.name: developerExperience
fields.label: Project developer experience

columns.name: projectTypes
columns.label: Project types
columns.description: Comma-separated. Values should align with CDOP 'project type' enumerated list, or 'Other'.

columns.name: registries
columns.label: Associated registries
columns.description: Comma-separated. Values should align with CDOP 'registry' enumerated list, or 'Other'.

columns.name: countries
columns.label: Project countries
columns.description: Comma-separated. Values should align with CDOP 'Country Name English Short Name' enumerated list, or 'Other'.

fields.description: Showcase the project developer's experience with developing other carbon credit projects that are relevant to the specific procurement request. Add rows as necessary.

fields.name: legalActions
fields.label: Active or threatened legal actions
fields.description: Are there any active or threatened actions, litigations, investigations or convictions against the project owners, project developers, shareholders, or members of the project management team? These investigations could be related to corruption, forced labor, gender-based violence/harassment, or other non-compliance with financial, social, or environmental regulations, impacts to local/indigenous communities, or any other matter that could be reasonably expected to negatively impact your entity or the project's reputation.

fields.name: legalActionsDescription
fields.label: Description of legal actions
fields.description: If yes to the above, describe the actions, investigations and/or convictions, alongside the entities or individuals involved. If issues have been or are being remediated, provide the steps taken to fully address the issues identified. (≤500 words)

fields.name: terminatedForNonPerformance
fields.label: Ever terminated for non-performance on a contract
fields.description: Has the project developer or affiliated implementation partners ever been terminated for non-performance on a contract?

fields.name: bankruptcy
fields.label: Ever filed or petitioned for bankruptcy
fields.description: Has the project developer or affiliated implementation partners ever filed or petitioned for bankruptcy?

fields.name: negativePress
fields.label: Negative press disclosure
fields.description: Describe any relevant negative press that the organizations responsible for the implementation of this project, or the project itself has received. Disclose any citations and/or links to articles if available. (≤200 words)

fields.name: carbonRights
fields.label: Carbon rights
fields.description: Describe the carbon rights of the project area. Include how the project addresses customary and statutory land rights, and identify precedents within the same or nearby jurisdictions, if possible. (≤500 words)

fields.name: landSelectionStrategy
fields.label: Land/site selection strategy and ownership
fields.description: Describe your land/site selection strategy and the ultimate owner(s) of the land involved (e.g. acquisition or leases from individual private landowners, collective landowners, or public concession model, etc.) as applicable. (≤500 words)

fields.name: landAccessStatus
fields.label: Land access / project siting status
options: Contract(s) signed for all of the planned project area
Contract(s) signed for some of the planned project area
Contract(s) in negotiation for all of the planned project area
Contract(s) in negotiation for some of the planned project area
Verbal discussions underway for some or all of the planned project area
Landowner/siting agreements not yet in negotiations
fields.description: Select the most applicable option for the project's status in securing land access/project siting.

fields.name: landOwnershipUnderStatute
fields.label: Land ownership granted by competent authority
fields.description: Can you confirm that all the land ownership associated with the project is granted under statute, regulation, or decree by a competent authority of the country in which your project is being developed?

fields.name: permitsRequired
fields.label: Permits or formal permissions
fields.description: What permits or other forms of formal permission (e.g., from regulatory agencies) do you require, if any, to engage in the implementation of your project? What else might be required in the future as you scale? (≤500 words)

fields.name: indigenousCommunitiesEngagement
fields.label: Indigenous communities engagement (UNDRIP, ILO 169)
fields.description: If Indigenous communities are impacted by the project, describe which communities and their location relative to the project, and explain what steps the project has taken to conform with the UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples and ILO's Convention 169 on Indigenous and Tribal Peoples. If no Indigenous communities are impacted or involved in the project, indicate N/A. (≤500 words)

fields.name: fpicAgreements
fields.label: Written FPIC agreements in place
fields.description: Do you have written agreements in place in which participating indigenous peoples and local communities (IPLCs) give free, prior and informed consent (FPIC) for their enrollment in the project?

fields.name: stakeholderMappingMethod
fields.label: Stakeholder mapping method
fields.description: Is stakeholder mapping for the project conducted in-house, by external consultants, by independent advisors, or through a combination of these methods? (≤20 words)

fields.name: communityContext
fields.label: Community context around project area
fields.description: Tell us about who lives in and around the project area, including potential marginalized communities, migration trends, IPLCs in or near the project area, or rural or urban communities that could be positively or negatively affected by the project. (≤500 words)

fields.name: localRisksAndMitigation
fields.label: Local social or environmental risks and mitigation
fields.description: Describe any local social or environmental risks the project faces. For each identified risk, describe potential impacts on the identified groups above and outline mitigation strategies you would take to reduce or manage the risk. Examples of risks include altering stakeholders' rights to food, housing, education, etc., perpetuating unequal power dynamics, habitat fragmentation due to project infrastructure, changes to water flow or quality, changes to soil conditions, or other attributes surfaced by the project's risk assessment process. (≤200 words)

fields.name: socioEnvironmentalOutcomesSelection
fields.label: Selection of socio-environmental outcomes
fields.description: How did you determine which socio-environmental outcomes are most important for the project to achieve or protect? Describe any methodology or framework you use or plan to use to select these outcomes and explain how they address the project's identified social and environmental risks. (≤500 words)

fields.name: socioEnvironmentalMonitoring
fields.label: Socio-environmental monitoring approach
fields.description: Describe how you will monitor socio-environmental outcomes, including data collection methods, frequency, responsibilities, and any third-party verification where applicable. (≤500 words)

fields.name: sdgs
fields.label: Sustainable Development Goals addressed
fields.description: Select which Sustainable Development Goals the project works to address.

fields.name: grievanceProcedure
fields.label: Grievance procedure and reported grievances
fields.description: Does the project have a procedure or policy to address disputes or grievances? If so, detail your procedure and any grievances reported to date. (≤200 words)

fields.name: iucnEcoregion
fields.label: IUCN ecoregion(s) or ecosystem(s)
fields.description: Using the IUCN's Global Ecosystem Typology, list the ecoregion(s) or ecosystem(s) the project is located in. (≤50 words)

fields.name: resourceNeeds
fields.label: Water/land/energy/other natural resource needs
fields.description: Describe the water/land/energy/other natural resource needs of the project in the first few years, and describe how these resource needs may evolve in the coming decade. Example descriptions may include kWh, gallons of water, or hectares per ton of carbon sequestered, depending on the type of project. (≤500 words)

fields.name: wasteAndByproducts
fields.label: Waste streams, residual materials, and byproducts
fields.description: Describe any waste streams, residual materials, or by-products associated with project activities, and how the project will manage these wastes to minimize health and environmental risks. Additionally, identify any other potential health and/or environmental risks and the mitigation strategies for each. (≤200 words)

fields.name: additionalRevenueStreams
fields.label: Additional revenue streams

columns.name: stream
columns.label: Revenue stream
options: Sale of physical products or commodities
Sale of environmental or ecosystem services
None, the only revenue is from carbon credit sale

columns.name: streamDescription
columns.label: Description of revenue stream
columns.description: Explain how and why it will occur during the project.

fields.description: What types of revenue streams, if any, are planned for your project in addition to carbon credits? Select all that apply and explain each item's role in the project's financial model. Add rows as necessary.

fields.name: fundingSources
fields.label: Funding sources for project development
fields.description: Provide details of funding sources for your project's development, including secured and planned funding. Add rows as necessary.

fields.name: deriskingInstruments
fields.label: De-risking instruments
fields.description: List any additional de-risking instruments the project has obtained or is in the process of obtaining (i.e. insurance products, loan guarantees, etc.). (≤200 words)

fields.name: offtakeAgreements
fields.label: Offtake agreements and forward sales
fields.description: Disclose any offtake agreements or forward sales and their status. (≤100 words)

fields.name: wacc
fields.label: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC)
fields.description: What is the project's approximate weighted average cost of capital (WACC)? (≤50 words)

fields.name: financingMilestones
fields.label: Key project development and financing milestones
fields.description: Provide key project development and financing milestones. Include relevant final investment decision (FID) milestones. (≤500 words)

fields.name: runwayWithConfirmedFunding
fields.label: Operational runway with confirmed funding
fields.description: How long could your entity sustain operations with confirmed sources of funding? (≤100 words)

fields.name: fortuneBuyers
fields.label: Fortune 100/500 buyers
fields.description: How many credit buyers do you have that are Fortune 100 or Fortune 500 companies, and in which business sectors? (≤20 words)

fields.name: creditsAvailable
fields.label: Credits available for delivery under this proposal
fields.description: Provide the volume of credits available for delivery under this proposal, and the project's maximum expansion potential over time. Clearly distinguish between volumes included in this offer and additional potential volumes not included. Volumes included in this offer should reflect only the credits available for contracting under this RFP proposal. Add rows as necessary.

fields.name: costUncertaintyDrivers
fields.label: Drivers of cost uncertainty
fields.description: What are the primary drivers contributing to cost uncertainty (e.g., labor rates, material costs, regulatory timelines, market conditions)? (≤200 words)

fields.name: buyerSeniority
fields.label: Buyer seniority applicable to offered credits
fields.description: Are credits that are indicated in the offer potentially subject to buyer seniority? (≤20 words)

fields.name: beneficiaryContributions
fields.label: Contributions expected from beneficiaries
fields.description: Identify what contributions (i.e., financial resources, time, land/labor inputs, support, etc.) that the project beneficiaries are expected to contribute to the project. (≤200 words)

fields.name: benefitDistribution
fields.label: Benefit distribution details

columns.name: beneficiary
columns.label: Name of beneficiary or beneficiary group

columns.name: benefitType
columns.label: Benefit type
columns.description: E.g., income, jobs, cash payments, revenue share, product sales, materials, ecosystem services.

columns.name: benefitDescription
columns.label: Description of benefit
columns.description: Specific explanation or concrete example of what will be delivered.

columns.name: expectedDuration
columns.label: Expected duration of benefit
columns.description: E.g., one-time, recurring, project lifetime, X years post-project.

fields.description: Describe both the monetary and non-monetary benefits provided to beneficiaries, including what they receive from the project and how those benefits are distributed. Add rows as necessary.

fields.name: carbonRevenueAllocation
fields.label: Carbon revenue allocation

columns.name: beneficiary
columns.label: Name of beneficiary or beneficiary group

columns.name: revenueStream
columns.label: Revenue stream
columns.description: E.g., carbon credits, forward sales, pre-purchase agreements.

columns.name: percentageShare
columns.label: Percentage share (%)
columns.description: Beneficiary's share of the revenue stream identified.

fields.description: Describe how carbon credit revenue streams are allocated among beneficiaries. Percentage Share (%) refers to the beneficiary's share of the revenue stream identified. Add rows as necessary.

fields.name: benefitSharingPlanDevelopment
fields.label: Benefit sharing plan development
fields.description: Describe the development of the benefit sharing plan, including: how beneficiaries, benefit types, and allocation approaches were determined; the consultation and decision-making process with beneficiaries; whether and how beneficiaries have agreed to the plan, and supporting evidence; any relevant existing or emerging regulations on benefit sharing (e.g., revenue sharing requirements with communities or government). (≤500 words)

fields.name: unanticipatedUpsideAllocation
fields.label: Allocation of unanticipated financial upside
fields.description: Does the project have a transparent and verifiable process for allocating unanticipated financial upside (i.e. revenues resulting from higher-than-expected carbon credit prices or project performance) to local communities or other stakeholders? Describe the process, decision-making authority, and reporting arrangements. (≤200 words)

fields.name: governmentSubsidies
fields.label: Government subsidies, grants, or incentives
fields.description: If applicable, describe any government subsidies, grants, regulatory incentives, policies or other relevant laws or regulations that support or promote activities in the project area. Please include: type and status (e.g., confirmed/awarded, scheduled, or expected/speculative); estimated contribution to total project revenue (%); relevant program details, including any applicable sector-specific programs (e.g., agricultural subsidies); and key eligibility requirements. (≤500 words)

fields.name: nationalPolicyContext
fields.label: National and sub-national policy context
fields.description: Briefly describe the key national and/or sub-national policies, regulations, or government frameworks relevant to the project's carbon market activity. Include any policies or regulations that materially affect the project or its eligibility to generate carbon credits; the relevant government ministry or public authority, where applicable; and a brief explanation of how or if the project aligns with national climate policies or commitments (e.g., NDCs or national climate strategies). (≤200 words)

fields.name: hostCountryAuthorization
fields.label: Host country authorization status
fields.description: Has the project sought or obtained host country authorization?

fields.name: intendedCreditUse
fields.label: Intended use of credits
fields.description: What is the intended use of the credits?

fields.name: correspondingAdjustments
fields.label: Corresponding adjustments expected
fields.description: Are corresponding adjustments expected or necessary?

fields.name: managingMethodologyUpdates
fields.label: Management of methodology updates and crediting rule changes
fields.description: How does the project plan to manage methodology updates, baseline reassessments, and changes in crediting rules? (≤200 words)

fields.name: viabilityWithoutCarbonRevenue
fields.label: Project viability in absence of carbon credit sales
fields.description: Please describe how and why the project may be able to continue in the absence of carbon credit sales. If the project includes other revenue streams, please explain how carbon revenue is required to make the project viable. (≤500 words)

fields.name: durabilityRisks
fields.label: Durability risks and evolution over time
fields.description: What durability risks does your project face and how are they expected to change over time? Include physical risks (e.g. leakage, decomposition and decay, damage, reversal, etc.), socioeconomic risks (e.g. mismanagement of storage, decision to consume or combust derived products, etc.), and outline any fundamental uncertainties about the underlying technological, geochemical or biological process. (≤500 words)

fields.name: durabilityGuaranteeTerm
fields.label: Durability guarantee term (years)
fields.description: What is the project durability guarantee term (years)? This is the number of years for which you will guarantee that the carbon remains sequestered and will offer compensation for any reversal. (≤50 words)

fields.name: nonPermanenceDiscount
fields.label: Non-permanence discount applied
fields.description: Has a non-permanence discount been applied? If yes, what is the rate as a percentage of estimated emissions reductions? (≤50 words)

fields.name: durabilityGuaranteeMechanism
fields.label: Durability guarantee mechanism
fields.description: Briefly explain the project durability guarantee: who is liable to remediate or compensate for reversals? In what form will you provide compensation (e.g., project-level or registry-level buffer pools, monetary permanence reserves, horizontal stacking, clawback provisions, risk-of-reversal discounts in original crediting, or other compensatory mechanisms)? Specify any differences in proposed compensation between intentional/avoidable reversals and unintentional/unavoidable reversals. If your proposed compensation includes a buffer pool, specify (1) the percentage of project removal metric tons and annual volume that will be contributed to the buffer pool, and (2) the current volume and composition of this pool. Specify if the buffer pool includes both removal and avoidance credits. (≤500 words)

fields.name: postCreditingDurability
fields.label: Post-crediting durability mechanisms
fields.description: If relevant, how will the project ensure that sequestered CO2e remains durable after the end of the crediting period? Describe the mechanisms that incentivize CO2e storage beyond this period, such as legal protections (e.g., conservation easements) or non-carbon economic incentives for landholders, or any other measures that support long-term permanence. (≤500 words)

fields.name: uncertaintyAssessment
fields.label: Uncertainty assessment result
fields.description: Has an uncertainty assessment been completed? If yes, what is the resulting uncertainty level as a percentage of estimated emissions reductions/removals? (≤50 words)

fields.name: quantificationApproach
fields.label: Primary emissions quantification approach
fields.description: What is the project's primary emissions quantification approach?

fields.name: sourcesOfUncertainty
fields.label: Sources of uncertainty
fields.description: What are your project's sources of uncertainty? (≤500 words)

fields.name: pilotLocalDataUsed
fields.label: Pilot or locally collected data used to validate estimates
fields.description: Has the project used pilot and/or locally collected data to validate the estimated project emissions or removals?

fields.name: leakageDiscount
fields.label: Leakage discount applied
fields.description: Has a leakage discount been applied? If yes, what is the rate as a percentage of estimated emissions reductions? (≤50 words)

fields.name: biomassWasteRisks
fields.label: Risks to biomass/waste/byproduct streams
fields.description: Describe risks that could lead to unintended consequences for your proposed biomass, waste, or byproduct stream (e.g. effects on supply chains, pricing, alternative uses of the waste, etc.) for both inputs and outputs of the process. For each identified risk, indicate the geographic scope (local, national, international); the potential impacts; mitigation strategies for reducing or managing the risk; and relevant standards or scientific literature used to inform your analysis. (≥500 words)

fields.name: leakageBeyondMethodology
fields.label: Leakage handling beyond methodology requirements
fields.description: Please describe how your project addresses leakage beyond any methodology requirements. Include plans for monitoring and accounting for leakage in design and operations. (≥500 words)

fields.name: mmrvBeyondMethodology
fields.label: MMRV practices beyond methodology requirements
fields.description: Please briefly describe any pieces of the project's MMRV plan which go above and beyond methodological requirements. (≤500 words)

fields.name: postCreditingMonitoringPeriod
fields.label: Post-crediting monitoring period and cadence
fields.description: What is the anticipated duration (in years) of the post-crediting monitoring period? How does the cadence play out over time (e.g. intensive up front monitoring, phase out over time, etc.)? (≤200 words)
